limitations: Single reader per instance, accessed over SSH tunnel.
Explicit guided-reading wording follows the frozen classifier; use 带我读, not 带我阅读.
External source images retain their original network dependency; bundled SVG tested separately.
Initial smoke-client workspace load timed out once; retained failure and successful fresh-page rerun, no server restart or product timeout workaround.
PDF final saved-note verification resumed from its real persisted record after correcting the acceptance selector; translation/highlight/save were performed through real UI.
